findings.claim: A sidecar started without a settings manager can still accept global MCP server mutations, violating the requirement that global MCP mutation is always disabled in sidecar mode.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criteria 2.27/3.8 require `PUT` and `DELETE /api/uar/mcp/servers/x` to return 409 in sidecar mode; `sidecar_locked` returns true only when `state.settings_manager.as_ref().is_some_and(|manager| manager.sidecar_feature_locks())`, and `save_server`/`delete_server` only refuse when that returns true, while `src/server.rs` only applies `with_sidecar_feature_locks()` inside `if let Some(p) = &persistence`.
findings.suggested_fix: Store an explicit sidecar-mode flag in `AppState`/MCP admin state and reject global MCP mutations based on that flag, independent of whether persistence/settings storage is configured.
